consistency.text_ja: On-Demandでは最高利益日 / 累計純利益が40%以下。部分出金後に窓をリセット。
consistency.text_en: On-Demand: best-day profit / cumulative net profit ≤40%. Window resets after a partial payout.

special_rules.title: Average holding time and profit conditions
special_rules.text: Average holding time across all trades must exceed two minutes, and a majority of trades must exceed two minutes. A profit-share condition for trades over two minutes also applies: evaluation uses the profit target; qualified uses total profit above initial capital.

max_dd.text_en: Fixed loss limit: 10% of initial capital.

refund_after_pass.text_ja: 合格後の評価費返金なし。第4回出金の裁量ボーナスは返金とは別。
refund_after_pass.text_en: No post-pass evaluation-fee refund. A discretionary fourth-payout bonus is separate.

max_lots.text_ja: 同時保有上限 40 Lot。初回超過は対象利益除外、2回目は終了。
max_lots.text_en: Total simultaneous holding cap 40 lots. First breach excludes affected profit; second ends the account.
